CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

June 11, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 6:59 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: May 28, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the May 28, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  2718 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00009

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) channel letter wall-mounted sign and
  exterior remodel along the façade of an existing 1-story commercial building
  fronting West Valley Boulevard.
  •  Applicant: Candice Park
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The project shall apply a durable, authentic, and quality finish on the
  inset wall face where the existing blue tile is being removed. Consider
  providing a smooth stucco finish to add another level of texture and to
  provide contrast to the façade, as well as present a high level of quality
  to the building design.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of plans for the City Architect
  to verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The project shall apply a durable, authentic, and quality finish on the
  inset wall face where the existing blue tile is being removed. Consider
  providing a smooth stucco finish to add another level of texture and to
  provide contrast to the façade, as well as present a high level of quality
  to the building design.
  2. Project shall show dimensions for all channel letters, characters, and
  symbols on the signage.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of plans for the City Architect
  to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ITEM 3:  105 South El Molino Street, DRB-2024-00042

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 1,281 SF 2-story addition to the back of
  an existing single-family residence, including a new rear covered porch.
  •  Applicant: Hip Serrano
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:18 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on June 25, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:18 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
